title: Introduce primer-led prefetch synthesizer and sparse telemetry packer
author: Aisha Khatri
description: Motivation: We need a lightweight, deterministic way to simulate and measure the effectiveness of primer-driven prefetch policies across multi-cohort workloads. Current bench runners exercise batching and warmup but do not provide a replayable prefetch allocator that prioritizes short-lived sessions and token-head hotpaths. This PR introduces two pieces: 1) a Primer-Led Prefetch Synthesizer (PLPS) — a workload generator that injects primer tokens and simulates cohort-specific prefetch budgets and eviction penalties; and 2) a Sparse Telemetry Packer (STP) — a compact exporter that encodes per-epoch prefetch decisions, hit/miss deltas, and prioritized-kv attributions for downstream analysis. Goals: reproduce intermittent p95 improvements observed in canary runs, provide deterministic inputs for kernel-level profiler runs, and reduce telemetry payload size during long synthetic campaigns.

release_notes: Introduce a primer-driven prefetch workload generator and compact telemetry exporter. Useful for prefetch policy evaluation and kernel-level profiling. No user-facing API changes.
notes_for_qa: To reproduce: run benchmarks/prefetch_cohort_simulation.yaml with --runner=plps and set STP_BINARY=0 for readable output. Use --seed to make runs deterministic. Expect end-to-end run time ~3x of a simple steady-state runner for 10k sessions.
how_to_validate:
1) Run unit tests: pytest -q benchmark-lab/tests/test_prefetch_synthesizer.py
2) Run a short integration: go run bench-tool -c benchmarks/prefetch_cohort_simulation.yaml --limit=500 --seed=42
3) Compare sparse_telemetry_packer output sizes with and without STP_BINARY enabled
rationale_and_context: This is part of a broader effort (ENG-8790) to quantify prefetching ROI across customer-like cohorts and to provide compact telemetry for long-running campaigns. Downstream: results will feed the perf-canary and kernel profiler suites to validate kernel-level benefits of prefetch policies.
audit_trail: Opened by Aisha Khatri on 2024-11-03. Requested changes addressed on 2024-11-06. CI flake retried on 2024-11-09. Merged on 2024-11-10.
examples_in_docs: Included a short example in docs/prefetch_synthesizer.md showing a cohort of 3 session types and sample output of STP JSON and binary encodings.
performance_notes: In internal microbenchmarks PLPS reduced measured cold-start p95 by ~8-12% when paired with a priority-prefetch allocator. End-to-end telemetry size reduced ~6x using STP binary encoding on long runs.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: synthetic prefetch patterns might overfit allocator heuristics. Mitigation: we ship multiple preset profiles (conservative, balanced, aggressive) and recommend validating against customer traces before policy rollout.
test_matrix: Python 3.9/3.10, linux-x86_64, quick/integration/long, coverage threshold 85% for new runner code
